mapper.select: SELECT C.*,M.MEMBER_NICKNAME,(SELECT CATE_VALUE FROM CATEGORY WHERE CATE_SEQ = C.COURSE_CATEGORY) AS CATE_VALUE FROM COURSE C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO WHERE COURSE_SEQ=#{courseSeq}
SELECT R.*, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME FROM COURSE_REVIEW R LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE COURSE_SEQ = #{courseSeq} AND REVIEW_DELETE_TIME IS NULL ORDER BY REVIEW_CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE_REVIEW WHERE COURSE_SEQ = #{courseSeq} AND REVIEW_DELETE_TIME IS NULL

SELECT r.rate AS REVIEW_RATE, COUNT(cr.review_rate) AS RATE_COUNT FROM ( SELECT 5 AS rate FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 4 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 3 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 2 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM dual ) r LEFT JOIN course_review cr ON cr.review_rate = r.rate AND cr.course_seq = #{courseSeq} AND cr.review_delete_time IS NULL GROUP BY r.rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.* FROM CURRICULUM C LEFT JOIN SECTION S ON C.SECTION_SEQ = S.SECTION_SEQ WHERE S.COURSE_SEQ = #{courseSeq} ORDER BY S.SECTION_ORDER, C.CURR_ORDER ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE_PROGRESS (PRG_SEQ, PRG_PLAY_TIME, PRG_TOTAL_TIME, PRG_CREATE_TIME, MEMBER_SEQ, COURSE_SEQ, SECTION_SEQ, CURR_SEQ) VALUES (SEQ_PROGRESS.nextval,${prgPlayTime},${prgTotalTime},SYSTIMESTAMP,${memberSeq},${courseSeq},${sectionSeq},${currSeq})
mapper.update: UPDATE COURSE_PROGRESS SET PRG_PLAY_TIME = ${prgPlayTime}, PGR_LAST_VIEW_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP, PRG_UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PRG_SEQ = ${prgSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT T.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE_PROGRESS P WHERE P.COURSE_SEQ = T.COURSE_SEQ AND P.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberNo}) AS PROGRESS FROM ( SELECT C.COURSE_SEQ,C.COURSE_TITLE,C.COURSE_THUMBNAIL,C.COURSE_TYPE,C.COURSE_CATEGORY,COUNT(C2.CURR_SEQ) AS CURR_COUNT FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN COURSE C ON C.COURSE_SEQ = O.COURSE_SEQ LEFT JOIN SECTION S on C.COURSE_SEQ = S.COURSE_SEQ LEFT JOIN CURRICULUM C2 on S.SECTION_SEQ = C2.SECTION_SEQ WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ORDERS_STATUS = 'PAID' GROUP BY C.COURSE_SEQ,C.COURSE_TITLE,C.COURSE_THUMBNAIL,C.COURSE_TYPE,C.COURSE_CATEGORY) T
